author: Sunflower State News
title: Kansas Rowing III Eight named Big 12 Boat of the Week after Minnesota Invite win
text:
Kansas Rowing’s III Eight was named the Big 12 Boat of the Week, the conference announced on May 6 after securing first place in their race at the Minnesota Invite.
The recognition highlights a strong performance by Kansas’ III Eight crew, which finished ahead of teams from Minnesota, Iowa, and Wisconsin. The team achieved a time of 6:57.8 on Lake Phalen in St. Paul, marking Kansas’ best overall standing at the regatta.
Head coach Andrew Derrick said, “We are really proud of that group. They clicked this year and have done a great job having fun learning to go fast. Can’t wait to see them race at conference.”
The III Eight is comprised of freshman coxswain Samantha Ronen; senior stroke Lauren Burright; seat seven freshman Ashley Herbert; seat six senior Catherine Bachovchin; seat five freshman Suyin Howard; seat four sophomore Morgan Tenpenny; seat three junior Andronika Dyer; seat two freshman Naida Paschal; and sophomore Audrey Crowson on bow.
This is the second time this season that a Kansas boat has received a Big 12 Weekly honor—the previous award came after the I Eight won its final race in the Dillon’s Sunflower Showdown on April 15. It is also notable as it marks the first time since 2021 that two Kansas boats have been named “Big 12 Boat of the Week” in one season.
Looking ahead, Kansas Rowing will compete next at Nathan Benderson Park in Sarasota, Florida for the Big 12 Rowing Championships against other conference opponents on Sunday, May 17.
